page: Amazon Web Services m9g.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical arm64 cores powered by AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V3 processors running at a sustained clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Each core hosts an independent single thread, supported by 64 KB of L1 data cache and 2 MB of L2 cache per core, alongside a shared 48 MB L3 cache pool. System memory totals 192.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cryptography via AES is enabled, while x86-specific vector extensions and hyper-threading are absent by design.

The hardware configuration includes a baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, requiring all operational data storage to be provisioned through networked block storage. The system does not include dedicated graphics processing units, which concentrates resource allocation entirely on scalar and vector CPU execution paths.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computational and memory performance. The m9g.12xlarge achieves top-tier results in Clang software compilation, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and static web serving throughput reaching 97.07 GB/sec. Memory subsystem evaluation demonstrates robust bandwidth, delivering 187.91 GB/sec on large uncached read blocks and supporting up to 136.27 million Redis SET operations per second. PassMark database tests similarly place in the upper decile, whereas single-core stress testing and local large-language-model inference speeds register in the mid-range spectrum.

Given its high core count, dedicated physical CPU allocation, and substantial memory throughput, the instance provides strong resource efficiency for multi-threaded server workloads. The absence of local disk IOPS requires reliance on network-attached storage, positioning the m9g.12xlarge best for in-memory data structures, distributed relational databases, heavy code compilation pipelines, web serving clusters, and containerized microservice backends.
description: Amazon Web Services m9g.12xlarge is a general-purpose Nitro instance equipped with 48 dedicated arm64 cores based on AWS Neoverse-V3 silicon at 3.3 GHz and 192.0 GB of RAM. Reflecting a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution, the architecture delivers high multi-threaded compute density alongside a 25 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance includes no bundled local NVMe storage and zero GPUs, directing all platform resources to memory bandwidth and multi-core processing. Benchmark testing highlights top-tier execution across software compilation, static web serving, and in-memory key-value operations such as Redis, while LLM inference and single-threaded operations remain moderate. The instance is suited for multi-tier microservices, large database backends, caching infrastructure, and high-concurrency enterprise workloads.
